questions.scenario: You visit the dentist's clinic. What fascinates you the most?

options.text: The drilling machines and the physical tools they use to pull out teeth.
The X-Ray screen showing the hidden roots of the teeth.
The 'Before and After' photos of people getting perfectly white, straight smiles.
The modern chairs, the AC waiting room, and how rich the dentist looks.

questions.scenario: Your friend gets braces (tar) on their teeth. What is your reaction?

options.text: I wonder if it hurt physically when the doctor tightened the wires.
I look closely at the angles and wonder how the wire pulls the teeth straight over time.
I help them choose cool, aesthetic colors for their braces bands.
I ask them how much it cost and realize braces are a highly profitable business.

questions.scenario: You have a block of clay or soap. What do you do with it?

options.text: I aggressively carve it, cut it, and mold it into a rough shape with tools.
I measure it with a scale and try to cut perfect symmetrical cubes.
I gently sculpt it into a beautiful, detailed flower or face.
I make multiple small shapes and pretend I'm selling them to my family.

questions.scenario: When you take a selfie for Instagram, what is your focus?

options.text: I don't care, I just click a quick, funny picture and post it.
I check the lighting angles and symmetry of my face.
I focus heavily on my smile, use filters to whiten my teeth, and look aesthetic.
I make sure my branded clothes or cool background is visible.

questions.scenario: In your house, something gets stuck inside a tiny gap (like a coin under the sofa).

options.text: I physically lift the heavy sofa to get it out.
I use a torch and a stick, calculating the exact angle to push it out.
I don't want to get my hands dirty, so I try to use a clean magnet or tape.
I tell my younger sibling I will give them ₹10 if they crawl under and get it.

questions.scenario: How do you eat a tricky food like Bhutta (Corn on the cob) or Sugarcane?

options.text: I just bite into it aggressively with my strong teeth.
I carefully pull out the corn kernels row by row systematically.
I prefer someone cuts it nicely into a bowl so it doesn't ruin my face or hands.
I buy the sweet corn cup from the mall because it's easier and premium.

questions.scenario: What kind of detailed hand-work do you prefer?

options.text: Using tools to tighten screws, fix cycles, or hardware work.
Solving tiny, complex mechanical puzzles or Rubik's cubes.
Doing fine arts, sketching, painting, or embroidery.
I prefer using my brain and mouth to talk, rather than doing tiny hand-work.

questions.scenario: You are watching an ad for a new toothpaste.

options.text: I care if it says it stops bleeding gums and kills germs.
I look at the 3D animation showing how the chemicals fight cavities logically.
I buy it if it promises 'Shining Diamond White Teeth' in 7 days.
I notice the branding, the actor they used, and how they market it.

questions.scenario: Which of these 'fears' do you NOT have?

options.text: I am not scared of blood, needles, or cutting things.
I am not scared of doing complex math or physics calculations.
I am not scared of doing extremely delicate, tiny detail work for hours.
I am not scared of taking financial risks or talking to strangers.

questions.scenario: What is the ultimate goal of your career?

options.text: To do heavy, respected medical surgeries and fix major jaw accidents.
To perfectly align things and solve long-term structural problems.
To make people look extremely beautiful and boost their confidence.
To own a massive, successful clinic chain and be my own boss.

Maxillofacial_Surgeon.title: Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon
Maxillofacial_Surgeon.primary_match_text: You are bold, physically active, and have very steady hands! You don't get scared of blood and love doing heavy, impactful medical work.
Maxillofacial_Surgeon.day_in_the_life: Performing complex jaw surgeries, pulling out wisdom teeth, and treating accident patients in the hospital.
Maxillofacial_Surgeon.alternative_match_text: Because of your steady hands and bravery, you would also be excellent in General Surgery or Orthopedics.
Maxillofacial_Surgeon.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. Clear NEET to pursue BDS, followed by an MDS in Maxillofacial Surgery.

Orthodontist.title: Orthodontist (Braces Specialist)
Orthodontist.primary_match_text: You have an incredibly analytical and structural brain. You love calculating angles, understanding mechanics, and seeing long-term results.
Orthodontist.day_in_the_life: Taking X-Rays, calculating exact tooth movement angles, and fitting braces or aligners to straighten teeth over months.
Orthodontist.alternative_match_text: If you ever decide against dentistry, your structural brain makes you a perfect fit for Architecture or Bio-Mechanical Engineering.
Orthodontist.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. Clear NEET to pursue BDS, followed by an MDS in Orthodontics.

Cosmetic_Dentist.title: Cosmetic Dentist / Prosthodontist
Cosmetic_Dentist.primary_match_text: You are the artist of the medical world! You have a highly creative eye for aesthetics and love making things look perfectly beautiful.
Cosmetic_Dentist.day_in_the_life: Doing teeth whitening, designing perfect ceramic smiles, and completely transforming a person's face and confidence.
Cosmetic_Dentist.alternative_match_text: With your love for aesthetics and beauty, you could also easily transition into Cosmetic Dermatology or High-end Jewelry Design.
Cosmetic_Dentist.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. Clear NEET to pursue BDS, followed by a fellowship in Cosmetic Dentistry.

Dental_Clinic_Owner.title: Dental Entrepreneur / Clinic Chain Owner
Dental_Clinic_Owner.primary_match_text: You have a brilliant business mind! You want the respected 'Doctor' tag, but your real passion is management, making money, and leading.
Dental_Clinic_Owner.day_in_the_life: Working as a dentist but spending more time marketing your clinic, hiring other doctors, and expanding your brand across the city.
Dental_Clinic_Owner.alternative_match_text: Your street-smart business approach means you would also excel in Hospital Administration or starting a Healthcare Tech App.
Dental_Clinic_Owner.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th to get a BDS degree, then pursue an MBA in Healthcare Management.
